summary: Bot AI v2 (Phase 1) verified. BACKEND 1: test_bot_ai_v2 10/10. Added randomized parity fuzz (test_bot_parity_fuzz.py): 600 self-played deals = 19,200 card decisions, Python vs TS identical play + partner_strength/capot/trumps_left/control (0 mismatches), every Python decision legal. BACKEND 2: duo vs_ai server game (tester1+tester2, 2 bots) driven over WS: bidding -> playing -> 32 plays -> hand_end (contract 90 H made, 130-40), no WS errors, no new 'auto driver error' in backend logs (the 7 existing ones are from 10:34-10:37, before a game_runtime reload; the cause, create_task on a Future in _reliability, is already fixed with ensure_future). BACKEND 3 + REGRESSION 5: tutorial_coach + tfaskira + void_deal + surcontre_window 47/47 green. FRONTEND 4: tester1 login at 844x390, then offline solo (Jouer contre l'IA > short). Bidding pass, bots bid (partner 90 D), I played 3 cards, bots replied, tricks resolved, illegal cards dimmed, no red screen, no JS errors (only a library warning about the transform-origin DOM prop). One logic gap found: partner estimation ignores the partner's public trump void (see backend_issues.minor). No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: The 'honest partner estimation' excludes J/9 that I hold or that were played, but it ignores PUBLIC voids. If the partner has already shown a trump void (did not follow a trump lead), partner_strength still returns 3 and team_trump_control returns True. Repro: trump H, partner seat2 bid 100 H, history [AD,7D,8D,9D | KH(s1),7C(s2 void H),AH,QH], hand [7H,8H,KD,QS,7S,8C]. Result: strength=3, control=True, bot leads 7H toward a partner with no trump, which feeds the opponents' J/9. Both engines behave the same (parity holds). Fix: return 0 when trump is in mem['voids'][partner] (optionally cap at 1 when J and 9 are both out of the partner's reach). Apply the fix in both engines and add a scenario.

action_items: partner_strength (bot_ai.py:127 and ai.ts partnerStrength): return 0 when the partner is publicly void in trump (mem voids[partner] has trump). This also fixes team_trump_control, the weak-trump open toward partner (bot_ai.py:385) and the capot allowance. Keep TS parity and add a scenario test.
critical_code_review_comments: best_endgame_order: 'tl -= 1' after a trump-master lead is conservative because every trump holder must follow, and tl also counts the partner's trumps. Acceptable heuristic, not a bug.
_lead safe_masters (bot_ai.py:401) excludes suits an opponent is void in, even when that opponent is known to have no trump left. Slightly conservative.
The parity_runner.cjs approach (sucrase-transpiled ai.ts) is solid. Consider keeping the fuzz parity test in CI because it covers far more states than the 9 hand-written scenarios.
